Players Committee errata-sheet slip of [[Kir Kanos (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2), game text: “When deployed, may take a Royal Guard into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During battle, if present at a site with an Imperial, once per game may cancel a non-[Immune to Sense] Interrupt.”

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/errata_102020.pdf Errata Sheet 2020 October] (Players Committee), page 1, PDF built 14 October 2020. The slip was cut from the page rendered at 300 dpi (the PDF draws its text over a background image), at the slip's outline.

Edits: none.
